import torch

text = "貓看狗。狗吃魚。貓看鳥。"
chars = sorted(set(text))
ids = [chars.index(char) for char in text]
counts = torch.ones(len(chars), len(chars))
for current, answer in zip(ids[:-1], ids[1:]):
    counts[current, answer] += 1
totals = counts.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
probability = counts / totals
row = chars.index("貓")
print(chars)
print(counts[row], totals.shape, totals[row])
print(probability[row])
assert torch.allclose(probability.sum(dim=1), torch.ones(len(chars)))

T = 16
prompt = ["〈user〉", "店名是小小書店。", "〈eos〉", "〈assistant〉", "好。", "〈eos〉"]
prompt += ["〈user〉", "現在", "只答", "店名。", "〈eos〉", "〈assistant〉"]
P = len(prompt)
print("前文長度P", P, "還能生成的位置T-P", T - P)
candidates = ["小小", "書店", "〈eos〉", "謝謝"]
for G in [4, 2, 5]:
    if P + G > T:
        print(f"G={G}：P+G={P + G} 超過 T={T}，拒絕這個設定")
        continue
    reply = []
    for token in candidates[:G]:
        reply.append(token)
        if token == "〈eos〉":
            break
    reason = "模型選了EOS" if reply[-1] == "〈eos〉" else "用完G"
    print(f"G={G}：新增{len(reply)}個token {reply}，停止原因：{reason}")
